deterministic_partition_reproduction.method: Exact donor source expression sorted(atoms, key=sha256(seed + NUL + atom)) with first 10 reserved.

findings.observed: load_atoms accepts any JSON list/object field containing exactly 46 unique non-empty strings. It does not verify membership in the measured accepted atom set, reject 'or', consume atoms_index row/token-ID records, or prove a content relationship to the supplied ABI manifest.
findings.implication: Hashing an arbitrary atom-inventory file beside an ABI-manifest file is provenance recording, not proof that the inventory is the manifest's accepted atom table.

findings.observed: materialize hashes tokenizer_path into tokenizer_identity_sha256 but never invokes the tokenizer against final prompt/target bytes and never checks atom token IDs, target token count, target position, codebook occurrence tokenization, or chat-template rendering.
findings.implication: Tokenizer identity presence is not tokenizer-consumption evidence. Real atom rows remain non-admissible until exact contextual tokenization is executed and bound.

findings.observed: validate_prehHoldout builds one raw joined prompt/target string and rejects when any held-out atom string is a substring. With the exact hash partition, held-out single-character atoms include R, P and C. Those characters occur in the donor's fixed non-atom renderer text (for example 'Return', proposition 'P', and 'CASE'). A deterministic local reproduction of the donor's renderer phrases found held-out R in templates 1/4, P in 1/2/3/4, and C in 2/4.
findings.counterhypothesis: If all atom lexemes were multi-character sentinel strings, substring screening could approximate leak detection.
findings.adjudication: That counterhypothesis does not apply to the measured 46-name ABI, which contains 36 one-character alphanumeric atoms. The current source check is valid for its synthetic ¤NN self-test but not for the real accepted alphabet.
findings.required_fix: Detect holdout-symbol leakage at explicit rendered codebook/target atom spans and/or exact tokenizer token IDs, never via unconstrained raw substring search.

findings.observed: The deterministic donor partition would reserve 'no' and 'false' among the ten unseen symbols, while 'yes', 'true', 'maybe', 'unknown', 'if', 'then', 'not' and 'and' remain pre-holdout-visible.
findings.hypothesis: Pretrained label/verbalizer priors can make unseen-symbol performance depend partly on lexical semantics rather than only episode-local binding generalization.
findings.counterhypothesis: Exact active-codebook counterbalancing makes this lexical prior negligible after binder training.
findings.required_discriminator: Report per-atom and neutral-alphanumeric-versus-language-bearing accuracy, including deliberately flipped mappings; do not collapse all ten unseen atoms into one metric.

findings.observed: The donor reserves 10 holdout atoms while its pre-holdout path forms disjoint groups of 3 from the 36 visible atoms. Ten is not divisible by three and the holdout body is intentionally absent.
findings.implication: A future holdout materializer must explicitly preregister how ten symbols participate in three-way episode codebooks while preserving per-atom/per-class balance. Reusing non-overlapping triplet chunking would leave a remainder and is not an admissible implicit choice.

method_support: Wei et al. 2023 symbol tuning: arbitrary labels can improve learning of in-context mappings and flipped labels.
Fei et al. 2023: label biases are an explicit in-context-learning failure class.
Kossen et al. 2024: in-context label relationships can be learned while pretrained prediction preferences may remain.
scientific_context.boundary: These papers motivate the nuisance test; they do not establish the effect on the measured Xeno checkpoint.

successor_requirements: Consume exact atoms_index.json records, not a free string list.
Cross-bind atom row, lexeme, accepted status, token ID and ABI manifest/member hash.
Explicitly reject 'or' and any atom outside the exact accepted 46.
Run the exact target tokenizer over final rendered bytes and verify every atom occurrence and target span against ABI token IDs.
Replace raw substring holdout leakage with span/token-aware leakage checks.
Freeze the actual holdout atom identities before evaluation and audit semantic-prior strata without exposing those strata to the model.
Preregister a balanced 10-atom holdout codebook schedule before opening holdout outcomes.
Keep family/provenance isolation and exact rendered-byte hashes in the same immutable split manifest.
next_exact_action: Do not merge or promote the PR1956 materializer as a real-ABI path. Salvage its factorial/counterbalance geometry into the current lane only after replacing free-string inventory admission and substring leakage with manifest-bound atoms_index plus exact contextual tokenizer/span verification; then materialize a small blinded pilot and measure semantic-prior strata separately.
